tldr.text: Risk-off inside tech led by semis and software: SPY -0.01%, QQQ -0.11%, SOXX -1.07%, IGV -1.04%, and XLK -0.43% on Wednesday May 27, 2026, while AI-platform megacaps were mixed and the tape punished several richly owned chip and cyber names.
QCOM closed -7.80% after profit-taking on an AI rally, despite ByteDance ASIC demand headlines.
ZS collapsed -32.99% after a FQ3 beat but softer FQ4 guidance and a more conservative FY27 framework.
TSM outperformed at +2.37% on Taiwan AI-capex headlines and Jensen Huang’s comments on Nvidia spending in Taiwan.
